name: Role
definition: Role of a party in an activity.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies the role of the party in the transaction.

Player.name: Player
Player.definition: Entity which plays a role in the context of the business domain in which the role is defined.

ContactPersonRole.name: Contact Person Role
ContactPersonRole.definition: Contact person in the context of a role played by an organisation.

CounterpartyRisk.name: Counterparty Risk
CounterpartyRisk.definition: Specifies the risk which is related to the role played by a party.

Entry.name: Entry
Entry.definition: Entry for which a role is specified.
